sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green count: {len(green_items)}")

positions = []
for n in green_items:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    positions.append((center_r, center_c))

# Exclude the special item (3, 33)
positions = [(r, c) for r, c in positions if (r, c) != (3, 33)]
positions.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
print(f"Positions to collect: {positions}")

# Get blue position
blue_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
if blue_items:
    blue_col = sum(p[1] for p in blue_items[0]['boundary']) // len(blue_items[0]['boundary'])
    print(f"Blue col: {blue_col}")

# Move character to far left
for _ in range(6):
    result = action(['LEFT'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
blue_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
if blue_items:
    blue_col = sum(p[1] for p in blue_items[0]['boundary']) // len(blue_items[0]['boundary'])
    print(f"Blue col: {blue_col}")

# Collect all non-special items
for r, c in positions:
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
    state = last_action_result.get('state')
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    green_count = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N')
    print(f"Clicked ({r}, {c}): green={green_count}, state={state}")
    if green_count > 10:
        print(f"  REGENERATION!")
        break
    if state == 'GAME_OVER':
        print("Game over!")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("Level completed!")
        break

# After collecting all non-special items, click the special one
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_count = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N')
print(f"Remaining green: {green_count}")
if green_count == 1:
    print("Clicking special item (3, 33)...")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 3, 'col': 33}])
    state = last_action_result.get('state')
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    green_count = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N')
    print(f"After special: green={green_count}, state={state}")
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("Level completed!")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
